causes.what: The hypervisor hv-02 has CPU saturation and contention (CPU util ~96%, CPU ready ~30%) starting about 13:31. This starves the VMs on it, apparently web-03 and web-04, and makes their HTTP responses about 7x slower. The monitoring data does not show which workload on hv-02 is consuming the CPU.

ruled_out: web-03/web-04 own CPU, memory and disk (normal, web-03 cpu 24%)
db-01/db-02 (conn count, replication lag and io wait normal)
network: core-rtr-01, dist-sw-01 and dist-sw-02 (links up, errors low, no ping loss)
web-01 and web-02 (response time normal, ~430-470 ms)
evidence: Only 2 open problems: Slow HTTP response on web-03 (13:35:09) and web-04 (13:35:18). No other trigger events in the last 120 minutes.
web-03 http.resp.ms jumped from ~375 ms at 13:33 to ~2970 ms at 13:34 and stayed at 3000-3500 ms. web-04 reads 3080 ms at 13:39. web-01 and web-02 are unchanged at ~430-470 ms.

hv-02 hv.cpu.util.pct was ~40-52% for the previous 90 minutes and is 96.5% at 13:38. hv.cpu.ready.pct was 1-3% until 13:30 and jumped to 19% at 13:31:49, then 24-31% through 13:38. hv-01 ready is 1.09%.

The hv-02 CPU-ready jump (13:31:49) precedes the web-03/web-04 slowdown (13:34), consistent with the hypervisor being the cause. I assume web-03 and web-04 run on hv-02 because no host tags record topology.
